description: This file defines classes for representing and managing a makefile directory tree, including building a pruned list of Android.mk files to avoid redundancy in build processes.

classes.name: MakeNode
classes.description: Represents a single node in the makefile directory tree, with methods for path management and sub-make inclusion checks.

classes.name: MakeTree
classes.description: Extends MakeNode to manage a collection of makefile nodes, providing methods to add paths, generate a pruned list of Android.mk files, and check if the tree is empty.

methods.name: MakeNode.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a make node with a name and optional parent, setting up path and children map.

methods.name: MakeNode._AddPath
methods.description: Adds a sequence of path segments to the node, creating child nodes as needed.

methods.name: MakeNode._SetLeaf
methods.description: Marks the node as a leaf node.

methods.name: MakeNode._GetPath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path associated with the node.

methods.name: MakeNode._DoesIncludesSubMake
methods.description: Determines if the node includes sub-makefiles by parsing Android.mk if it's a leaf.

methods.name: MakeNode._DoesParentIncludeMe
methods.description: Checks if the parent node includes sub-makefiles.

methods.name: MakeNode._BuildPrunedMakeList
methods.description: Builds a list of Android.mk files for leaf nodes not included by parent nodes.

methods.name: MakeTree.AddPath
methods.description: Adds a directory path to the tree, creating nodes and marking leaves.

methods.name: MakeTree.GetPrunedMakeList
methods.description: Returns a minimal list of Android.mk files needed to build all leaf nodes.

methods.name: MakeTree.IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the makefile tree has any nodes.
